services.desc: Welcome to Fast Track Swimming in Cypress, TX - your destination for fun, fitness, and family-friendly activities. Our Cypress location offers expert swimming lessons for all ages and skill levels, taught by certified instructors in a state-of-the-art indoor facility. Whether you’re learning to swim for the first time or refining advanced techniques, we provide a safe and supportive environment. In addition to our swimming programs, we feature 2 air conditioned, top-quality Pickleball courts that can be used for half-court basketball, making Fast Track a hub for active lifestyles and community recreation. blurb: We start at 6 months and up and pride ourselves in being one of the swim schools helping Texas fight drowning prevention with our water safety program. What sets us apart from other swim schools is our class sizes for beginners. We never put your child in a group class full of non swimmers. Years and years of teaching success has taught us that throwing children in a group class is unsafe and puts them at risk.
